01 / CUSTOMIZE

A frame that fits.

Choose the full print size, including the white border on Instax photos. The frame covers 2 mm of each edge.

02 / PRINT

Two parts. One keepsake.

Download the frame as 3MF for easy color assignment, or STL for a single material. Download the backing STL too. Start with PLA, 0.2 mm layers and 3 walls. Frame exports back down with embossed details facing up. Enable supports under photo lips, bows and dividers.

03 / KEEP

Swap the photo. Keep the story.

Original model: slide the photo and backing in from the top. Wreath & bow: load from the rear and twist the three-tab backing to lock. Other reference styles: follow their backing instructions.

Designed for home 3D printing. Test the fit before printing a batch; adjust in your slicer for your printer’s tolerances. Check support placement beneath photo lips and bows before printing. Hanging loop adds 8.5 mm above the frame body.
